about: Classes for tools/solver/scan_draw_observers.py's entries (FIGHT_SOLVER.md section 17). observer: the macro draw is off while the named test in Solver/MacroDraw.cs DrawObservers.All holds; safe: a run of plain draws over a fixed multiset ends in the same state whatever the cards' order, and the count drawn does not depend on their values. Each with why. rest-take: a take of a card of the unknown middle outside the draw loop; a draw after it in the same run is sequential (the named run rule in Solver/Successors.cs).

draw-loop:Add.why: the drawn card lands in hand and in the draw's result list in draw order; the hand's order is read only where the key keeps the hand in order, and the macro draw is off there (hand-ordered); result readers are classed as draw-result

draw-loop:AutoPlayDrawnCard.why: plays a drawn Strike inside the draw (HellraiserPower.AfterCardDrawnEarly): what is played, and whether the rest is drawn, follow the order

draw-loop:BindOnDraw.why: binds the first cards drawn in the owner's turn, up to the power's amount (BoundCardsThisTurn): which cards are Bound follows the order

draw-loop:ConfuseCostOnDraw.why: Confused re-rolls a drawn card's cost on its own stream, independently per card; the roll is a chance call between draws, so a run of plain draws ends at it

draw-loop:CountDrawnCardForAutomation.why: Automation counts the cards drawn; the count, not the order, decides its energy

draw-loop:DamageAllForSpeedster.why: hits every enemy per card drawn mid-turn: a kill stops the draw at a fight's end, and a death's effects see the hand drawn so far

draw-loop:DrawForIteration.why: the first Status card drawn this turn draws more: the count drawn depends on the values, and where the extra cards land on the order

draw-loop:DrawForPagestorm.why: an Ethereal card drawn draws more: the count drawn depends on the values

draw-loop:Get.why: BuffSystem.Get: reads a buff for the Hellraiser test (classed with AutoPlayDrawnCard and IsStrikeCard)

draw-loop:GrowKinglyCardOnDraw.why: Kingly Kick and Kingly Punch grow per copy as they are drawn: the same for any order

draw-loop:HellraiserPlaysDrawnStrike.why: Hellraiser's count of the Strikes it plays into enemies that all show infinite HP (HellraiserPower.AfterCardDrawnEarly): from the tenth in a turn a Strike stays in hand, so which are played, and when the hand fills, follow the order

draw-loop:IsOverOrEnding.why: the fight-end check before each card: the fight ends inside a draw only through an observer (Hellraiser's play, Speedster's hit); the safe effects here cannot kill

draw-loop:IsStrikeCard.why: Hellraiser's test of the drawn card

draw-loop:Max.why: a drawn Void's energy loss, Math.Max(0, energy - 1): the same total for any order

draw-loop:PoisonAllForCorrosiveWave.why: Corrosive Wave poisons every hittable enemy per card drawn: the same total for any order; poison does not hit until it ticks

draw-loop:ReferenceEquals.why: where a Hellraiser-played card came to rest (the Hellraiser path, an observer)

draw-loop:RemoveFromDrawPileAt.why: the take off the top: the draw itself, which the solver watches

draw-loop:RollSlitherCost.why: Slither re-rolls a drawn card's cost on its own stream, independently per card; the roll is a chance call, so a run of plain draws ends at it

draw-loop:ShuffleIfNecessary.why: a reshuffle inside the draw runs AfterShuffle, where Stratagem's pick opens a screen and puts a card of the player's choice in hand mid-draw; the reshuffle itself is safe (it comes at a count that does not depend on the order, and the solver keeps the reshuffle epoch)

draw-result:DrawUntilNonAttack.why: Pillage draws until it draws a non-Attack: the count drawn depends on the values and their order

draw-result:EscapePlan.why: draws one card and reads its type: a one-card draw is never a macro node

draw-result:Scrape.why: discards the cards it drew that do not cost 0, in draw order, through the discard command: discard triggers and Sly plays fire in that order

kernel-hook:AfterCardDrawn.why: a listener a switched-on kernel family (F11) registers on a drawn card: the kernel's listeners are not classed one by one, so while any is registered the draws are sequential

take:AutoPlayCardRepeatedly.why: takes the replayed card back from wherever it rests, the draw pile included (found by place): a card of the unknown middle taken outside the draw loop reads the layout

take:AutoPlayFromDrawPile.why: plays cards off the top of the draw pile (Havoc, Mayhem): the top of the unknown middle is the layout's front

take:AutoPlayFromPile.why: plays the card at an index of the pile its caller chose: a card of the unknown middle by its place

take:DrawCards.why: the draw loop's own take off the top, marked with its draw call (PlainTake): the macro draw itself

take:DrawPileToHand.why: a screen's choice from the draw pile: the screen's answer replays the step, where the macro draw is off (screen-answer)

take:DrawRareCards.why: takes the pile's Rare cards picked on a stream, by index into the pile: which copies are taken follows the layout

take:ExhaustFirstDrawPileCard.why: exhausts the top card of the draw pile: the layout's front

take:ExhaustFromDrawPile.why: a screen's choice from the draw pile: the screen's answer replays the step, where the macro draw is off (screen-answer)

take:ExhaustStatusesFromPile.why: exhausts every Status in the pile: the multiset taken does not follow the layout, but the take is outside the draw loop and the run rule does not tell the kinds apart

take:JeweledMask.why: takes a Power picked on the card-selection stream by index among the pile's Powers in pile order: which copy is taken follows the layout

take:MoveFirstDrawPileCardOfTypeToHand.why: takes the first card of a type in pile order: which card is taken follows the layout

take:MoveZeroCostDrawCardsToHandForPower.why: takes the pile's zero-cost cards in pile order: the set does not follow the layout, the order they reach the hand does

take:QueueCombatStartAutoPlays.why: takes the Imbued cards out of the draw pile at the combat's start, by index: the start of a fight, before any solve, classed with the rest

take:RemoveFromDrawPileAt.why: the take itself (CombatState.RemoveFromDrawPileAt): every caller is an entry here

take:ShuffleDiscardIntoDraw.why: the reshuffle empties and refills the draw pile: the solver keeps the reshuffle epoch, and the new epoch's draws are a node of their own

take:StealDrawOrDiscardCard.why: Thieving Hopper's steal: Rng.CombatCardGeneration.NextItem over the draw and discard cards of the best rarity tier, in pile order: the stolen card follows the layout. Before the next turn's draw it cut the macro block at the stolen card's slot and the replay drew past the block (g7-emu N8ST89LTSW k0106-k0112)

take:ToastyMittens.why: exhausts the top card of the draw pile (the first non-Innate on turn one): the layout's front
